name: SN Tempest Air Racer
description: A single-seat air racing vehicle built for the GLMZ Air Grand Prix — a semi-legal racing circuit through the city's airspace that draws massive crowds and even bigger betting pools. The Tempest is pure speed: anti-grav lift, hydrogen turbine, minimal safety systems, and an aerodynamic profile that looks like a knife blade with a cockpit. Pilots experience G-forces that require augmented physiology to survive. The Air Grand Prix has a 4% fatality rate per race. Tickets sell out in minutes.
propulsion: Anti-grav lift, hydrogen turbine thrust, vectored nozzles
autonomy: Manual pilot with G-force management AI
armament: None. Racing regulations prohibit weapons. Regulations are loosely enforced.
common_usage: Air racing, speed records, corporate sponsorship vehicle, pilot ego.
story_hooks: A Tempest pilot discovers their racer's AI is subtly adjusting their course during races — steering them away from a specific area of airspace
A racing team's Tempest disappears during a race and isn't found for three days — the pilot insists only minutes passed
physical_description: The Tempest is a sleek, knife-blade fuselage of scuffed titanium-composite with heat-scorched panels from repeated hydrogen turbine burns. The single teardrop cockpit sits flush against the hull, its reinforced canopy scratched from countless near-misses through GLMZ's tight airspace. Faded Sterling-Nakamura racing stripes run its length, and the undercarriage bristles with anti-grav emitters that hum with barely-contained power.
